:::{#exm-odds-auto}
#### Odds that a car in the Auto data is American

In the Auto data of @exm-random-experiment,
let $A$ be the [event](#def-event) that a car [chosen at random](#def-random-choice) is American,
which the data code as `origin == 1`.
Its [probability](#def-probability) is the fraction of American cars,
as in @exm-random-choice-auto,
and its [odds](#def-odds) follow from @def-odds:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
auto <- read.csv("data/auto.csv")
p_american <- mean(auto$origin == 1)
c(probability = p_american, odds = p_american / (1 - p_american))
```

The odds `{r} round(p_american / (1 - p_american), 2)` say that
an American car is about `{r} round(p_american / (1 - p_american), 1)` times as likely
as a car of non-American origin.
:::
